environment: Disposable Chrome MV3 with localhost-only pregrant and synthetic CVAT Redux/input. No company data or personal browser. Permission prompt and deployed CVAT are not tested.

previous missing navigation follows actual current CVAT frame

Job-specific selection and last result survive closing popup

changing required labels invalidates old result

overlay executes vendor JSON review and displays the same missing results
